name: ritik-karak-portfolio
description: MERN portfolio for Ritik Karak — Video Editor, Web Developer & Meta Ads specialist

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run check:videos && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
